question: Which of the following became India's first fully solar powered district in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Diu**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
__ 
 
• **Diu** became India’s first **fully solar-powered district** in **May 2025**, showcasing the country’s commitment to renewable energy initiatives. 
 
• This achievement is part of the **Government of India’s push towards renewable energy**, aiming to reduce dependence on conventional fossil fuels and mitigate climate change. 
 
• With the installation of **13 MW solar power plants** (both ground-mounted and rooftop), Diu successfully meets its daily energy needs through solar power. 
 
• The initiative has significantly reduced the district’s reliance on **electricity supplied from the Gujarat grid**, thus lowering electricity costs and transmission losses. 
 
• Diu’s efforts have also contributed to achieving the **national renewable energy targets**, aligning with India’s commitment under the **Paris Agreement**. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
__ 
 
• **About Diu:** 
 
 
• Diu is a coastal district in the Union Territory of **Daman and Diu**, situated in western India. 
 
• It is known for its **rich cultural heritage**, historic forts, scenic beaches, and now, its focus on sustainable energy. 
 
 
 
• **India’s Renewable Energy Goals:** 
 
 
• India has set an ambitious target of **achieving 500 GW of renewable energy capacity** by 2030. 
 
• The country aims to source **50% of its energy requirements** from renewable sources under its **National Solar Mission**. 
 
 
 
• **Importance of Solar Power:** 
 
 
• Solar energy is a clean, sustainable, and abundant source of power, reducing **greenhouse gas emissions** and combating global warming. 
 
• It helps in **energy security** by reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels. 
 
 
 
• **Other Solar-Powered Success Stories in India:** 
 
 
• **Cochin International Airport:** The world’s first fully solar-powered airport, located in Kerala, India. 
 
• **Charanka Solar Park:** A large-scale solar park in Gujarat, contributing significantly to the state's renewable energy output. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Solar Energy Projects:** 
 
 
• Reduction in **carbon footprint**, aligning with environmental sustainability goals. 
 
• Creation of **local job opportunities** in installation, maintenance, and operations of solar plants. 
 
• Improvement in **energy independence** and reduction in transmission losses. 
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Solar Adoption:** 
 
 
• **High initial installation costs** remain a barrier for large-scale adoption in some areas. 
 
• Issues like **land acquisition** and availability of skilled manpower can delay project implementation. 
 
• Dependence on weather conditions affects the consistency of solar energy generation.
